PLAN "12-Week Strength and Hypertrophy"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:

  GOAL secondary hypertrophy:
    name "Improve body composition through muscle gain"

      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower A":

          hip_circles 1x10
          leg_swings 1x10

          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds

          hamstring_stretch 1m
